description: This file defines the NavigationRenderer class responsible for rendering navigation components in a Drupal module, including building navigation bars, top bars, and managing local tasks and logos.

classes.name: NavigationRenderer
classes.description: Final class responsible for rendering navigation components, including building navigation bars, top bars, managing logos, and local tasks within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as config factory, module handler, route match, local task manager, image factory, file URL generator, section storage manager, request stack, module extension list, current user, and entity route helper.

methods.name: removeToolbar
methods.description: Removes the toolbar from the page top render array if present.

methods.name: buildNavigation
methods.description: Builds the navigation bar by adding a render array with cache settings and lazy builder callback.

methods.name: doBuildNavigation
methods.description: Pre-render callback that constructs the navigation render array, including logo handling and content top section.

methods.name: getContentTop
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the content for the 'content_top' section, including invoking modules and sorting items.

methods.name: buildTopBar
methods.description: Builds the top bar for content entity pages if the user has permission.

methods.name: doBuildTopBar
methods.description: Lazy builder that returns a simple top bar render array.

methods.name: removeLocalTasks
methods.description: Alters the local tasks block to hide it if local tasks are present.

methods.name: getLocalTasks
methods.description: Retrieves and caches local tasks based on user access and route, excluding current route tasks.

methods.name: hasLocalTasks
methods.description: Checks if there are local tasks to display in the top bar.
